answer: The onyx multiplier is published, charged in delta, and pearl lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 19 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 1740 identities would post 3010 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
